app.title: Finder Selection Sync
app.subtitle: macOS · Local file workflows
task.orphans.description: Keep the reference format and find files without a matching original.
task.tags.description: Sync your selections to exports, or update Finder tags in bulk.
task.list.description: Use a filename list to decide which files to keep or move to Trash.
folder.chooseTargets: Choose one or more target folders
folder.drop: Click to choose or drop from Finder
action.resetAllHint: Clear all folders and filename lists in this workflow
rule.orphanNote: All other extensions are eligible, including XMP, PSD and video. Extensionless files are kept. Processing suffixes are preserved.
rule.syncNote: Ignores folders, extensions, case and -[processing suffixes]. Untagged references are skipped by default.
rule.colorNote: The chosen color replaces all existing Finder tags on selected files.
rule.clearNote: Removes all Finder tags from selected files.
rule.keepNote: Eligible files outside the list will be moved to Trash, including originals and sidecars.
rule.deleteNote: Only eligible files matching the list will be moved to Trash.
rule.pasteHint: Paste below. Spaces within filenames are preserved.
preview.title: Preview
preview.noResultsHint: Change the search or show all files.
preview.conflict: Conflicting reference tags. Resolve them before applying changes.
preview.emptyTitle: See what will happen to each file
preview.emptyHint: Choose the folders to start. Any rule change updates the preview automatically.
preview.tagsSummary: {count} files will have their tags updated
preview.large: Large folders may take a moment
preview.stopped: Preview stopped. Change a rule or refresh to resume.
reason.referenceProtected: Reference file or its hard link; kept.
reason.noReference: No matching {extension} reference. Processing suffixes are preserved.
reason.noRelativeReference: No matching {extension} reference in the same relative folder. Processing suffixes are preserved.
reason.listProtected: The list file or its hard link; kept.
reason.notIncludedExt: Not among the included extensions; kept.
reason.listKeepHit: Listed; the current rule keeps listed files.
reason.listKeepMiss: Not listed; the current rule keeps only listed files.
reason.listDeleteHit: Listed; the current rule moves listed files to Trash.
reason.listDeleteMiss: Not listed; the current rule moves only listed files.
reason.hardLink: This file has hard links. Tags cannot be changed independently for one path; skipped.
reason.conflict: Reference files have conflicting tag sets. Resolve the conflict before applying.
reason.mergeTags: Matches a reference. Tags will be merged. Folders, extensions, case and -[suffixes] are ignored.
reason.replaceTags: Matches a reference. Tags will be replaced. Folders, extensions, case and -[suffixes] are ignored.
reason.clearTags: Within the selected scope; all Finder tags will be removed.
reason.colorTags: Within the selected scope; all Finder tags will be replaced with the selected color.
reason.unchanged: Not selected, no eligible reference tags, or already synchronized; unchanged.
reason.targetMatch: Matching filename found in target folders
warning.hardLinks: Skipped {count} files with hard links to avoid changing tags on unselected paths.
progress.cleanup: Scanning folders and preparing the cleanup plan…
progress.verify: Checking for changes since the preview…
run.recover: Completed files can be found in macOS Trash.
run.tagsSaved: Completed tag updates have been written to Finder.
run.partialTags: Tags on a failed file may be partially written. Preview again to check.
run.cancelNote: Stopping does not undo completed operations.
run.exportHint: Export the file list and results for this operation.
history.clearHint: Clear activity records only. Files and exported reports are kept.
history.title: Activity
history.description: Last 20 operations in this session · Export before quitting to keep a record
history.emptyHint: Completed operations appear here with their results and an export option.
language.title: Language
language.invalid: {count} language packs could not be loaded. Check their JSON and _meta.label.
dialog.trashNote: Only checked files will be processed. Folders are kept. You can find moved files in macOS Trash.
dialog.tagsNote: Apply the tag changes shown in the preview. Automatic undo is not available.
error.emptyReference: No files with the reference extension were found. Check the folder and extension.
error.emptyList: The list is empty. Add filenames or choose a populated list.
error.overlap: Folders overlap or are repeated. Choose independent folders.
error.stale: Files, folders or references changed after preview. Processing stopped; preview again.
error.permission: This location cannot be accessed. Check macOS file permissions or choose another folder.
error.missing: A file or folder no longer exists. Choose it again or refresh the preview.
error.root: Choose a specific folder rather than the filesystem root.
error.utf8: Use a UTF-8 plain-text list with one filename per line.
error.listPath: Use valid file entries. Relative paths cannot be absolute or contain parent traversal.
error.boolean: This setting must be true or false.
error.path: Choose a valid file or folder with an absolute path.
error.extensions: Separate extensions with commas, for example jpg,jpeg.
error.duplicateTarget: That target folder is already selected. Choose a different folder.
error.depth: Depth must be a non-negative integer. Leave it blank for no limit.
error.referenceExt: Enter one reference extension, for example NEF.
error.listSize: A filename list cannot exceed 2 MB.
error.cancelled: Preview stopped. Refresh or change a rule to continue.
error.expired: This preview is no longer valid. Preview again.
error.conflict: Resolve the conflicting reference tags before applying.
error.selection: Select files to process. Duplicate selections are not allowed.
error.notCandidate: The selection contains files outside the previewed changes.
error.unknownSender: Request from an unknown page was rejected.
error.singlePath: Choose one file or folder here.
error.knownPath: This path is not part of the current task.
error.report: This activity report is no longer available.
error.desktop: Open this interface in the Finder Selection Sync desktop app.
error.overlapOrphans: Folders overlap or are repeated. For originals and exports in one folder, choose “Same folder” above the folder cards. Otherwise choose independent folders.
error.overlapTags: Finder tag workflows need separate reference and target folders. Choose different folders that do not contain each other.
error.overlapList: Target folders overlap or are repeated. Select each folder only once, without including its parent or child folders.
preview.swipeHint: Scroll up to make room for the preview. Click the workflow title to show all options again.
image.title: Image preview
image.unavailable: This image could not be previewed
image.finderHint: You can view the original file in Finder.
preview.expandedHint: Search, filter and select files. Your selection stays in sync with the workspace.
